name: walkway-strip
prompt: Use case: game texture asset. The strip is vertical, occupies the middle ONE QUARTER of a tall portrait canvas, with transparent empty margins on left and right. It continues STRAIGHT through both TOP and BOTTOM canvas edges, CUT OFF there, absolutely NO rounded caps or transparent end margins. All four corners of the painted strip reach the image top/bottom. Appearance at top and bottom must MATCH for seamless vertical tiling, identical widths and brightness and line phase. A simple continuous directional ground decal, not a perspective path or scene. Physical width1.6 units; no objects, no railings, no cast shadows, no gradients across length. Crisp alpha side edges with very slight natural wear, avoid fuzzy halo. Generate long vertical texture, ideally256x2048 usable strip.
